$description: Color / Active — contrast mode. All values alias the 'contrast' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to give it maximum visual weight (high-contrast text, critical emphasis). Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'contrast'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for contrast components

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for contrast-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for contrast-colored components
